name: Corpus-relative claim support controls v1
provenance: Maintainer-authored calibration controls. Expected labels are withheld from the native judge request, but visible source/tasks and same-family judge do not make this a blind independent quality benchmark. The scorer measures agreement with supplied labels, never objective external truth. Exact quotes are copied from original fixed documents and provenance evaluated separately.

documents.title: Approval contract
documents.text: Approval is bound to the exact tool name and arguments. Changing the payload invalidates the decision. Saving approval does not execute the operation.

documents.title: Uncertain write recovery
documents.text: Interrupted non-idempotent writes require reconciliation. Confirm the original operation's external outcome before deciding how to continue. Do not silently repeat the write.

documents.title: Budget admission
documents.text: Persist the worst allowed model spending reservation before dispatch. Keep uncertain reservations when a request may have incurred a charge. Generation budgets exclude embedding and tool-service charges.
